lines.text: The Servant says the LORD called Him from the womb and hid Him in His quiver like a polished arrow.
The LORD calls Him His Servant, Israel, but He has labored in vain, yet His reward is with God.
It is not enough to raise up Jacob's tribes, so the LORD will make Him a light for the nations.
To the One the nation despised, the LORD says kings will see Him and rise, and priests will bow down.
People will come from far away, from the north and from the west, and from the land of Sinai.
